name: ClearBandstandObjectsByCategorySelector

name: CompareParkDesignerObjectsForDraw

name: CompareParkDesignerObjectsBySortLayer

name: FindTopmostParkDesignerObjectAtCursor
notes: Scans depth-sorted placed-object pointers back-to-front, applies filter mode and exact bound-area polygon hit test, returns persistent record index or -1

name: HitTestParkDesignerToolbar
notes: Hit-tests current mouse position against the sentinel-terminated Park Designer toolbar rectangles and returns control index or -1

name: DrawParkDesignerToolbarAndHover
notes: Draws Park Designer toolbar button states and emits DYP_G hover voice IDs for mode/delete controls

name: PointInsideRectExclusive
notes: Strict integer point-in-rectangle test used by Park Designer interaction helpers

name: PlayInputInterruptibleParkDesignerVoice

name: LoadSpudSkateTimingData

name: UpdateAndDrawSpudSkatePlayback
notes: Exact synchronized-run runtime: quality 0..3 selects bad/normal/ok/good Bink, stunt-trigger score += quality, return-to-Bad latches, first frame-660 special final-stunt score, second frame-660 end.bik transition, score display and result voices

name: LoadSpudMazeData
notes: Parses five-screen spudmaze_nodes graph, applies Y-11 correction, reads 5x4 reference triples, difficulty speeds/timers/spawns, animation delay, and trailing screen point lists

name: UpdateSpudMazeBobMovement
notes: Updates Bob graph traversal/input and handles 0x80/0x400 left-screen and 0x100/0x800 right-screen lane transitions

name: UpdateSpudMazeBobAnimation
notes: Advances Bob animation; repair state 9 runs repair sequence and decrements repairs-remaining when animation completes

name: DrawAndUpdateSpudMazeScene
notes: Draws current screen, damaged repair spots, Bob, dropped hammer, timer/counter and activity overlays; handles repair activation and hammer pickup

name: HandlePilchardCollisionAndHammerDrop
notes: On valid Bob/Pilchard collision drops hammer at Bob +/-10, y+41, clears has-hammer, starts 500-tick cooldown, and plays Bob/Pilchard reactions

name: ResetPilchardSpawnDelay
notes: Exact two-store reset: sets Pilchard controller state global 0x5109CC to 0 and delay/countdown global 0x5107E8 to 500

name: UpdateSpudMazePilchard
notes: Pilchard graph/path state machine for spawn delay, pursuit/navigation, animation and Bob collision interaction

name: UpdateSpudMazeMrBentleyNarrationSequence
notes: Multi-state Mr Bentley animation/narration controller using SS1_MRB_01..05 (713..717); advances timed sprite frames and chooses outcome/progress lines based on repairs-remaining state

name: LoadSquirrelData
notes: Loads sqdata.txt: 7 shared X motion deltas, 8x7 Y motion profiles, step delay, two discarded scalars, four stored-but-unread legacy scalars, and live initial-X alignment offset70; five-pair tail unread

name: UnloadSquirrelActivityResources
notes: Registered Squirrel teardown; releases activity DirectDraw surfaces/resources during completion or exit

name: BuildSquirrelFrameRect
notes: Builds 90x134 sprite source rectangle from a retail frame index

name: SelectSquirrelPlacementMotionProfile
notes: Builds four 36-entry retail piece/run lookup tables, selects four motion keys 0..13 from current run geometry into 0x514EE0..0x514EEC, then clamps keys nonnegative

name: DrawAndUpdateSquirrelActivityScene
notes: Main Squirrel scene composition/update path: blits scrolling/run background, advances squirrel/placement animation state, draws squirrel and Lofty/conveyor actors, and services scene sound/animation timers

name: GenerateSquirrelConveyorChoices
notes: Builds current conveyor item choices from difficulty and run progress, populating active flags, piece values and item positions

name: StepSquirrelPlacementActorTowardTarget
notes: Moves current placement actor x/y by two pixels toward target, snapping each axis when within three pixels and reporting arrival

name: UpdateSquirrelPlacementInteraction
notes: Nine-state conveyor selection/Lofty placement machine: select item, fetch it, commit primary/alternate placement, return or recycle piece

name: LoadGrandOpeningMachineData
notes: Parses machinedata.txt: 10 machine positions/sizes, 3 parsed-but-unused conductor positions/sizes, 3 frame counts, and 10 static animation rectangles

name: SaveAndUnloadBobsBandActivity
notes: Releases Bob’s Band resources, writes selected 5x24 grid as 120 int32 values to music{conductor}{player}.txt, then writes current conductor five times to binary last.txt

name: DrawGrandOpeningCompositionAndMachines
notes: Exact source-level compositor: opaque music_01 background -> row-major event bricks -> Scoop/Dizzy/Lofty/Muck/Roley machine layers with 15/30-frame short/long animation -> selected conductor idle/special-idle sheet -> keyed toolbar overlay

name: CanPlaceGrandOpeningEvent
notes: Checks a machine event span against 24-step row bounds and requires all target cells to be -1

name: RemoveGrandOpeningEventAtCell
notes: Deletes an event from a composition cell; continuation value 10 scans left to the owning 0..9 start and clears its full 1/2-step span

name: PlaceGrandOpeningEvent
notes: Writes machine type 0..9 at event start and fills remaining duration cells with continuation marker 10; previews selected WAV variation

name: UpdateGrandOpeningToolbar
notes: Exact strict-rect Play/Stop/Clear/Delete controller: conductor-family hover/click voices, Play managed-audio gate into state 8, Clear Deletebricks confirmation context 2, Delete cursor toggle and wall-scoped lifetime

name: PlayAndDrawGrandOpeningComposition
notes: Playback renderer/timer: advances 24 one-second steps, starts row-selected machine WAVs, animates machines/conductor and draws timeline state

name: DecodeBobsBandGridCell
notes: Decodes selected 0..119 grid-region index as row=index/24 and column=index%24

name: UpdateBobsBandBrickCursorAndDelete
notes: State-1 editor action path: same palette type toggles off, different type changes held brick, wall action11 places/replaces with restore-on-failure, continuation cells are not owner-resolved, and action22 normalizes the delete cursor when applicable

name: HandleBobsBandEditorAction
notes: State-0 editor action path: palette select cancels delete, previews brick and kicks idle machine animation; wall action 11 owner-resolves pickup/delete; special action 22 normalizes delete cursor

name: HitTestBobsBandRegions
notes: Scans exact 132-region table: 120 wall action-11 cells, ten palette actions 0..9, special actions 22/23; uses strict bounds and +10,+10 hotspot in state1 vs +5,+5 otherwise

name: FileTimeDeltaCentiseconds
notes: Shared FILETIME low-DWORD delta helper used by Bob's Band and Fireworks; divides 100ns ticks by 100000, yielding 10ms/centisecond units

name: UpdateProgressScreen
notes: Draws/interacts with Mr Bentley progress screen, renders completed activity stars, plays progress feedback, and updates finale lock/unlock flags from slots 50..64

name: SaveAndUnloadPlayerProfiles
notes: Releases player/profile UI resources, writes playerinfo.txt, then saves five playerN.txt files with exactly 100 ASCII int32 progress values each

name: InitializeAndLoadPlayerProfiles
notes: Loads profile UI/resources and playerinfo.txt, zeros five 100-int progress records, then reads player1.txt..player5.txt as ASCII integers

name: DrawEnterNamePopup
notes: Draws enter-name background, selected badge, centered typed-name glyphs, and blinking text cursor

name: UpdateEnterNamePopup
notes: Handles keyboard name entry/backspace, badge arrows, Start/Back controls, creates the selected profile, and routes new profiles through scene-set movie state 0x41

name: UpdatePlayerProfileScreen
notes: Draws and updates the five wooden player signs; supports selecting existing profiles, choosing empty slots for name entry, deleting profiles, and quit/back handling

name: PreparePlayAgainTransition
notes: Shared activity-completion presentation: stops/releases activity music, blits quitmain.bmp, stops managed sounds, plays PA_BOB_01.wav ID573 with managed arbitration, and marks that slot input-interruptible before outer state 0x3C

name: NoOpLegacyHook
notes: Function body is a single RET; numerous legacy/front-end call sites pass ignored arguments before continuing

name: CreateMainGameWindow
notes: Registers WINNAME class with MainWindowProc, creates/shows the Bob the Builder window, and returns HWND plus accelerator handle

name: InitializeDisplayForGameWindow
notes: Thin startup wrapper around CreateOrResetDisplayManager using global windowed/fullscreen mode

name: MainWindowProc
notes: Win32 window procedure: destroy/shutdown phase, move/size display rect, DirectInput acquire state, fullscreen system-command filtering, mode toggle and timing messages

name: RunActiveGameFrame
notes: Exact active-frame ordering: >100 CD counter validation, duplicate-time early return, bitmap reload/help reset, sound reap, help/main-flow dispatch, DirectInput poll, cooperative-level sleep/recreate/error branches, present and surface-lost restore

name: PresentGameFrame
notes: Calls DisplayManager::PresentDisplay and preserves failing HRESULTs

name: RestoreAllDirectDrawSurfaces
notes: Calls IDirectDraw7::RestoreAllSurfaces and preserves failing HRESULTs

name: FullscreenSystemKeyHook
notes: WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook installed only in fullscreen; suppresses system-key combinations including Alt+Enter/F4/Tab/Esc and Ctrl+Alt+Delete-style input

name: UpdateDirectInputAcquireState
notes: If primary device null returns1; otherwise frame-active acquires both DirectInput devices, inactive/minimized unacquires both, then returns0

name: PollDirectInputAndUpdateState
notes: Per-frame pointer poll + 256-byte keyboard state; DIK Left/Right/Up/Down/Space -> bits1/2/4/8/0x10, keyboard cursor step1 or4, relative deltas, hotspot-aware bounds clamp, click/cursor redraw globals

name: ShutdownDirectSound8
notes: Releases the global DirectSound8 manager object and clears its global pointer

name: AbortForRemovedRetailCD
notes: Fatal CD-removed path: marks fatal exit, destroys display, shows CD Removed error, posts quit, tears down input/audio/sound manager and exits CRT

name: PlayHelpVoice
notes: Context-help voice helper: optionally stops all managed sounds, then plays supplied sound ID at priority 50 with managed-sound arbitration class 2

name: EnterContextualHelpMode
notes: Draws retained background, activates help mode, plays GENH_WEN_01 (476), maps current outer game-flow state to one of 20 help contexts, with profile/progress special cases

name: UpdateContextualHelpMode
notes: Draws retained help background, runs context-specific and helpinfo.txt hotspot hit tests, plays hover/help voices, and exits help mode from common help/back region

name: UpdateHelpButtonController
notes: Shared Help-button state machine: hit-test/draw Help control, advances activation phase 0->1->2, switches help cursor and stops current sounds before EnterContextualHelpMode

name: EnableInputProcessing
notes: Sets shared DirectInput-processing gate at 0x0043ED14 to 1

name: DisableInputProcessing
notes: Clears shared DirectInput-processing gate at 0x0043ED14

name: UpdateGenericHelpHoverVoice
notes: While normal cursor surface is active, checks hover/input bit, draws progress/help hover overlay when applicable, debounces with global 0x51C374, and plays sound 456 or 475 from front-end mode flag 0x51C370

name: BeginLoadingCursorAnimation
notes: Switches active cursor/sprite to 0x51C260 loading surface, initializes 100x100 source rectangle and six-frame loading animation state

name: EndLoadingCursorAnimation
notes: Restores normal cursor surface 0x4FBF88 and clears loading-animation flags

name: UpdateLoadingCursorAnimation
notes: While loading surface is active, polls input and advances six 100px-wide animation frames

name: DrawLoadingCursorAnimation
notes: Blits current loading-animation frame at fixed (280,190), centering the 100x100 loading sprite on 640x480

name: SetCursorHotspotOffset
notes: Stores caller X/Y cursor hotspot offsets directly to globals 0x4FBD48/0x4FBD4C

name: ClearCursorHotspotAndClampNonnegative
notes: Zeros cursor hotspot globals then clamps shared mouse X/Y globals 0x4FBD24/0x4FBD30 to at least zero

name: ResetMouseBoundsToGameViewport
notes: Sets exact cursor bounds minX=2,minY=2,maxX=637,maxY=477 for the 640x480 game viewport

name: ReleaseInputAndCursorResources
notes: Unregisters/releases normal/loading cursor surfaces and DirectInput keyboard/mouse interfaces during teardown

name: SearchShortestSpudMazeGraphPath
notes: Recursive DFS over four node links; rejects cycles, accumulates Euclidean edge distance, and copies the lowest-cost route into the shared best-path buffer

name: BuildShortestSpudMazeGraphPath
notes: Initializes best-distance/path globals, seeds the start node, then calls SearchShortestSpudMazeGraphPath

name: DistanceFromActorToCurrentScreenNode
notes: Converts actor float X/Y to integers, looks up target node coordinates on current Spud-Maze screen, and returns integer Euclidean distance

name: UpdatePilchardAnimation
notes: Advances Pilchard sprite animation/state and publishes transition-frame offsets used by graph-motion correction

name: MovePilchardTowardGraphNode
notes: Moves Pilchard toward a target node at the supplied speed using angle-based motion; applies animation-aware Y snapping/offsets during lane transitions

name: MaybePlayRandomSpudVoice
notes: Occasionally selects a nonrepeating voice from SS1_SPU_01..04 (722..725) while the Spud Maze scene is active

name: DrawSpudMazeScreenTransition
notes: Draws current/adjacent screen backgrounds during horizontal lane transitions, advances slide offsets/counter, and keeps repair-layer rendering aligned until transition completes

name: UnloadSpudMazeActivityResources
notes: Unregisters/releases Spud Maze screen, Pilchard, repair, toolbar and per-screen damaged-section surfaces; clears activity state and stops shared activity music

name: UnloadSpudSkateActivityResources
notes: Closes Spud Skate Bink handles, frees retained movie/path buffers, unregisters/releases score/UI surfaces, clears cursor resources and activity state

name: UpdateAndDrawSquirrelLevelTransition
notes: Runs the inter-level transition: slides level/background framing geometry, draws transition pieces, advances current level when complete, and resets transition/conveyor state

name: UpdateAndDrawSquirrelRunAssembly
notes: Exact run assembly animator: maps motion keys via [0,0,3,3,5,5,4,4,2,2,0,0,1,1], applies sqdata shared X + selected Y deltas over substeps0..2 then3..6, advances sprite/run states and draws assembly

name: UpdateSquirrelConveyorSlideCycle
notes: Moves conveyor horizontal offset through its out/in cycle, advances conveyor animation phase, regenerates choices when fully offscreen, then slides the new set back in

name: FileTimeDeltaMilliseconds
notes: Subtracts the low DWORD of two FILETIME values and divides 100ns ticks by 10000; Fireworks calls it but discards the return, while its scheduler actually uses FileTimeDeltaCentiseconds

name: SeekAndDecodeBinkToExactFrame
notes: Uses BinkGetKeyFrame/BinkGoto, locks a DirectDraw surface, decodes/copies frames forward with BinkDoFrame/BinkCopyToBuffer/BinkNextFrame until the requested exact frame, then unlocks

name: ComputeSpudMazeBobInputDirection
notes: Resolves Bob X/Y movement intents from mouse direction around Bob or DirectInput direction bits, returning -1/0/+1 axis values before graph traversal

name: DebounceMazeDirectionalInput
notes: Maintains three-sample histories for X/Y movement intents; if either axis is not stable across all three samples, zeros both output intents to suppress direction flicker

name: DrawParkDesignerSegmentedPondSurface
notes: Draws all horizontal source strips for the currently selected Pond shape, using per-variant strip count/width/height tables and the sorted object position

name: DrawParkDesignerPondSurfaceSegment
notes: Draws one Pond-shape source strip selected from object +0x40 and bound-variant metadata

name: UpdateAndDrawParkDesignerFountain
notes: Advances the special object-code-7 fountain animation/timers and blits the active 152px-wide frame from the Summer/Winter fountain sheet

name: DrawSortedParkDesignerObjects
notes: Walks the sorted object-pointer array and dispatches Pond segment, fountain, Bandstand/Decorate, and ordinary object drawing paths

name: ParkDesignerRectanglesDoNotOverlapBySamplePoints
notes: Samples corners and edge midpoints of two rectangles via PointInsideRectExclusive; returns 0 when sampled overlap is found and 1 when no sampled overlap is found

name: CanPlaceParkDesignerObjectWithoutOverlap
notes: Scans active placed objects other than the selected record and uses the retail sampled-overlap predicate to validate a proposed placement

name: CompactParkDesignerObjectRecordFamilies
notes: Compacts holes in Pond-primary records 0..99 and Decorate records 300..399, rewrites self indices, repairs special-record globals, and updates next-record counters

name: FinishParkDesignerObjectDrag
notes: If an existing object is being dragged, restores its active/render flag except the retail Bandstand special case, clears drag state, and restores the normal cursor

name: CSound_SetVolume
notes: Game-added CSound helper: calls IDirectSoundBuffer::SetVolume for every buffer and ORs HRESULT results

name: UnloadMazeActivityResources
notes: Unregisters/releases Maze DirectDraw surfaces and actor/resource objects, clears Maze globals, and stops shared activity music

name: MsvcStringAssignSubstring
notes: Statically linked Dinkumware/MSVC basic_string assign(source,pos,count); common callers use pos=0 and npos to copy the full source string

name: MsvcStringTidy
notes: Dinkumware/MSVC copy-on-write basic_string tidy/reset helper; decrements/frees backing storage when requested and zeros pointer/size/capacity

name: MsvcStringAssignBuffer
notes: Dinkumware/MSVC basic_string raw-buffer/count assignment path; grows storage as needed, copies bytes, sets size, and NUL-terminates

name: MsvcStringSetEnd
notes: Dinkumware/MSVC basic_string end-of-string helper; writes logical size and terminating NUL

name: MsvcStringGrow
notes: Dinkumware/MSVC basic_string grow/trim helper; handles COW references, capacity checks, allocation and empty-string cases

name: MsvcStringAllocateCopyBuffer
notes: Dinkumware/MSVC basic_string allocation/copy helper; rounds capacity, allocates COW-prefixed storage, copies old bytes and updates size/capacity

name: MsvcStringDetachSharedBuffer
notes: Dinkumware/MSVC basic_string copy-on-write detach/freeze helper; releases shared reference, allocates private storage, copies bytes and NUL-terminates

name: DisplayManagerDestructor
notes: Restores the DirectDraw display-manager vtable and tail-calls ReleaseDisplayResources at 0x00402FF0

name: CSound_Constructor
notes: Customized DSUtil CSound constructor; exact 0x14-byte object stores vptr, copied DirectSound-buffer pointer array, buffer size, CWaveFile pointer, and buffer count

name: CSound_ScalarDeletingDestructor
notes: MSVC scalar-deleting destructor wrapper for customized CSound

name: CSound_Destructor
notes: Customized DSUtil CSound destructor; releases all DirectSound buffers, frees buffer-pointer array, destroys/frees owned CWaveFile
